supplements.title: Thlaspi arvense attenuates colitis-associated colorectal tumorigenesis through suppression of neutrophil recruitment via the NOD/NF-κB pathway.
supplements.summary: Thlaspi arvense plant extract reduces colorectal cancer development by blocking excessive neutrophil recruitment through an inflammatory pathway.

supplements.title: UCHL1 promotes osteosarcoma progression via deubiquitination and stabilization of LDHB.
supplements.summary: UCHL1 protein drives osteosarcoma growth by stabilizing LDHB; blocking UCHL1 with cryptochlorogenic acid reduces tumor progression.

supplements.title: Sex-based differences in circulating microRNA and metabolite signatures associated with physical activity in Lynch Syndrome carriers.
supplements.summary: Physical activity reduces colorectal cancer risk differently in men and women with Lynch syndrome through distinct molecular pathways involving microRNAs and metabolism.

supplements.title: Less Is More: A Physiological Dose of Vitamin B12 Enhances Neural Recovery Compared to a High Dose in an H₂O₂-Stressed SH-SY5Y Neural-Like Cell Model.
supplements.summary: A physiological dose of vitamin B12 promotes better neural cell recovery from oxidative damage than a high dose by enhancing antioxidant defenses and lipid remodeling.

supplements.title: Liquiritin Enhances Chemosensitivity to Doxorubicin in Breast Cancer by Promoting Ubiquitination-Mediated Degradation of MCL1.
supplements.summary: Liquiritin enhances breast cancer cells' sensitivity to chemotherapy by breaking down a protein that blocks cancer cell death.

supplements.title: 18-β-glycyrrhetinic acid facilitates nuclear-mitochondrial communications to alleviate oxidative stress through HMGB1-cGAS-Mul1 axis in tendinopathy.
supplements.summary: A natural compound called 18-β-glycyrrhetinic acid reduces tendon damage by decreasing harmful stress inside cells through a specific molecular pathway.

supplements.title: Fructose: metabolic signal and modern hazard.
supplements.summary: Fructose uniquely promotes fat accumulation and metabolic disease more than glucose, with emerging links to cancer and dementia.

supplements.title: Chasteberry extract alleviates rotenone-triggered testicular injury in rats by modulating oxidative stress, inflammation, apoptosis, and mitochondrial dysfunction.
supplements.summary: Chasteberry extract protects rat testes from pesticide damage by reducing oxidative stress, inflammation, and cell death.

supplements.title: Curcumin-Integrated Smart Nanocarriers: A Multi-Stimuli-Responsive Platform for Targeted Delivery of 5-Fluorouracil in Cancer Therapy.
supplements.summary: Smart nanocarriers enhanced curcumin and 5-fluorouracil delivery to cancer cells, improving drug effectiveness in breast and liver cancer models.

supplements.title: Effect of Probiotics on the Clinical Outcome and Inflammatory Response in Gastric Cancer Surgery: A Double Blinded Randomized Control Trial.
supplements.summary: Probiotics given to gastric cancer surgery patients reduced inflammation and improved recovery outcomes by restoring healthy gut bacteria.

supplements.title: Exploring the mechanisms of Cangfu Daotan decoction in homotherapy for heteropathy of polycystic ovary syndrome, insulin resistance, infertility, and obesity.
supplements.summary: A traditional Chinese herbal formula may treat polycystic ovary syndrome, insulin resistance, obesity, and infertility through four key plant compounds.

supplements.title: Exploring the mechanisms of luteolin in treating polycystic ovary syndrome and endometriosis via network pharmacology, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulation.
supplements.summary: Luteolin, a plant compound, may effectively treat polycystic ovary syndrome and endometriosis by targeting multiple genes and pathways simultaneously.

supplements.title: JI-CJ002 and Dabrafenib Combination Enhances Antitumor Activity in Melanoma Associated With the Downregulation of B7-H3.
supplements.summary: Combining an herbal extract with melanoma drug dabrafenib enhances tumor shrinkage by reducing a protein called B7-H3.

supplements.title: Temporally Programmed and Laser-Triggered Immunomodulatory Hydrogel Enables Synergistic Wound Healing and Prevention of Postoperative Tumor Recurrence.
supplements.summary: A specialized hydrogel implanted at colorectal cancer surgery sites prevents complications, heals wounds, and kills remaining tumors when triggered by laser light.

supplements.title: Multi-omics reveals gut microbiome- and metabolome-specific responses to sugar alcohols.
supplements.summary: Different sugar alcohols uniquely alter gut bacteria and metabolites, with isomalt showing the greatest health benefits in rats.

off_label.title: Extracellular Vesicle-Transferred ATP-Citrate Lyase Induces Monocyte Differentiation Toward Tumor-Associated Macrophages and Fuels Hepatocellular Carcinoma Progression.
off_label.summary: Hepatocellular carcinoma cells send vesicles containing an enzyme that converts monocytes into immunosuppressive tumor-supporting cells, offering a new treatment target.

off_label.title: White adipose atrophy exacerbates cold stress and accelerates aging in male mice.
off_label.summary: Fat tissue loss accelerates aging in male mice by triggering cold stress; warming reverses aging signs and extends lifespan.

off_label.title: Nicotinamide N-methyltransferase as a therapeutic target in taxane-resistant castration-resistant prostate cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking NNMT protein reversed taxane resistance in prostate cancer by suppressing TGFβ signaling and epithelial-mesenchymal transition pathways.

off_label.title: mTOR-driven integrin β4-enriched extracellular vesicles from lenvatinib-resistant hepatocellular carcinoma fuel lung metastasis via fibroblast-niche formation.
off_label.summary: Drug-resistant liver cancer cells release particles enriched with integrin β4 that promote lung metastasis and can be blocked with existing drugs.

off_label.title: Clinical Study to Evaluate the Possible Safety and Efficacy of Dapagliflozin in the Prophylaxis of Doxorubicin-Induced Cardiotoxicity in Breast Cancer Patients
off_label.summary: Dapagliflozin may protect breast cancer patients' hearts from damage caused by doxorubicin chemotherapy.

off_label.title: Metformin in Diatetes and Beyond: Therapeutic Mechanisms, Lactic Acidosis, Organ-Specific Effects, and Nanotechnology-Based Delivery Strategies.
off_label.summary: Metformin shows promise for treating cancer and other diseases beyond diabetes, with nanotechnology delivery improving safety and effectiveness.

off_label.title: Precision Oncology Trial Puts Off-Label Prescribing to the Test.
off_label.summary: Off-label targeted cancer drugs work best when tumors have specific genetic markers like MSI-H, helping guide treatment decisions.

off_label.title: Lomitapide mesylate and lomitapide target ALDOA to inhibit growth and enhance gemcitabine efficacy in PDAC.
off_label.summary: Lomitapide drugs target ALDOA protein to slow pancreatic cancer growth and boost gemcitabine effectiveness.

off_label.title: Pre-Emptive Amlodipine for FOLFIRINOX-Induced Hypertensive Crises Without Primary Hypertension: A Novel Chronotherapeutic Strategy.
off_label.summary: Pre-emptive amlodipine dosing timed before chemotherapy infusions safely controlled blood pressure spikes in a pancreatic cancer patient receiving FOLFIRINOX.

off_label.title: Circadian disruption exacerbates MASH by reducing Akkermansia muciniphila via the FXR-CYP7A1-bile acid axis.
off_label.summary: Circadian disruption worsens liver disease by reducing beneficial gut bacteria through disrupted bile acid metabolism, reversible with bacterial or drug treatments.

off_label.title: Association between inhaled corticosteroids and anti-PD-1/PD-L1 efficacy in patients with NSCLC with concurrent COPD.
off_label.summary: Inhaled corticosteroids for COPD improve lung cancer immunotherapy response in patients with both conditions.

off_label.title: ACLY-Driven Metabolic Reprogramming Promotes Histone Acetylation and Inflammation-Associated Fibrosis in Chronic Kidney Disease.
off_label.summary: ACLY enzyme drives kidney fibrosis by increasing histone acetylation and inflammation; blocking it reduces fibrosis in chronic kidney disease.

off_label.title: Efgartigimod as Rescue Therapy for PD-1 Inhibitor-Associated Myasthenia Gravis, Myocarditis, and Myositis (MMM) Syndrome: A 2-Case Report and Literature Review.
off_label.summary: Efgartigimod shows promise as a rescue treatment for severe immune-related muscle and heart complications caused by cancer immunotherapy drugs.

off_label.title: CRITICAL ROLE OF DYSREGULATED AUTOPHAGY IN PATHOPHYSIOLOGY OF PODOCYTOPATHY.
off_label.summary: Restoring autophagy in kidney cells shows promise for treating podocytopathies by reducing protein loss and improving cell function.

off_label.title: Perindopril and L‑arginine protect against arsenic trioxide-induced neurotoxicity via Keap1/Nrf2/HO‑1 activation and suppression of neuroinflammation and apoptosis.
off_label.summary: Perindopril and L-arginine together protect against arsenic trioxide's nerve damage in leukemia treatment by reducing inflammation and cell death.

biomarkers.title: miR-133a-3p and miR-338-3p shape neural crest derivatives in zebrafish.
biomarkers.summary: Two microRNAs control neural crest cell development, affecting craniofacial cartilage and pigment cell formation in zebrafish embryos.

biomarkers.title: Mechanistic study of MUC3A in promoting progression of clear cell renal cell carcinoma via the JAK‑STAT pathway.
biomarkers.summary: MUC3A protein promotes clear cell kidney cancer progression through the JAK-STAT pathway, offering a potential therapeutic target.

biomarkers.title: PINK1‑mediated mitophagy enhances breast cancer proliferation through metabolic reprogramming.
biomarkers.summary: PINK1 protein promotes breast cancer growth by triggering mitochondrial recycling that reprograms metabolism toward glucose burning.

biomarkers.title: Clinical and genetic characteristics of head and neck paragangliomas from China featuring Sino-European comparisons.
biomarkers.summary: Head and neck paragangliomas are rare tumors linked to genetic mutations in SDH genes, with patterns varying between Chinese and European populations.

biomarkers.title: Type I interferons induced upon respiratory viral infection impair lung metastatic initiation.
biomarkers.summary: Respiratory viral infections trigger immune proteins that prevent breast cancer cells from establishing lung metastases.

biomarkers.title: Molecular cancer prevention: Intercepting disease.
biomarkers.summary: Cancer prevention through early intervention before disease develops could reduce global cancer burden more effectively than treating advanced cases.

biomarkers.title: CT and MRI in the Characterization and Preoperative Assessment of Adrenocortical Carcinoma: Current Concepts and Perspectives.
biomarkers.summary: CT and MRI imaging help diagnose adrenocortical carcinoma and plan surgery, improving outcomes for this rare aggressive cancer.

biomarkers.title: Prenatal Diagnosis of Renal Cysts and Diabetes Syndrome (RCAD): A Case Report.
biomarkers.summary: Chromosomal microarray analysis successfully identified HNF1B gene deletion causing prenatal kidney cysts and diabetes syndrome in a fetus.

biomarkers.title: Thrombus composition identifies distinct etiologic phenotypes in embolic stroke of undetermined source.
biomarkers.summary: Blood clot composition helps identify different causes of unexplained strokes, revealing which ones likely originate from the heart versus arteries.

biomarkers.title: [Research progress on protein lactylation modification in malignant tumors].
biomarkers.summary: Lactate, produced abundantly in tumor cells, chemically modifies proteins to drive cancer growth, immunity evasion, and drug resistance.

biomarkers.title: [Expression and significance of the FABP6 long transcript in clear cell renal cell carcinoma].
biomarkers.summary: FABP6 protein shows promise as a potential biomarker and treatment target for clear cell kidney cancer.

biomarkers.title: [Development and validation of a multicenter nomogram predicting the risk of liver metastasis after curative resection of colorectal cancer].
biomarkers.summary: Researchers created a prediction tool to identify colorectal cancer patients at highest risk of liver metastasis after surgery.

biomarkers.title: [Exploration and clinical application of the 'digital and intelligent surgery' diagnosis and treatment workflow for oral and maxillofacial tumors].
biomarkers.summary: Digital and intelligent surgery using 3D imaging, AI, and navigation technology improves precision in oral and maxillofacial tumor removal and reconstruction.

biomarkers.title: [Clinical strategies for perioperative management of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma in the immunotherapy era].
biomarkers.summary: Combining immunotherapy with chemotherapy before surgery improves treatment outcomes for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma better than traditional approaches.

biomarkers.title: [Novel clinical insights and frontier issues in alpha- fetoprotein-producing gastric cancer].
biomarkers.summary: AFP-producing gastric cancer shows aggressive behavior; multiple tumor markers and immunotherapy offer potential for personalized treatment strategies.

trials.title: Implementing integrative nursing for oncology inpatients: a retrospective analysis of project-related routine data from 2021 to 2023.
trials.summary: Integrative nursing interventions, including naturopathic treatments, were successfully implemented to support cancer inpatients' care and symptom management.

trials.title: The effect of acupuncture on hot flashes and sleep disturbances in women with breast cancer receiving endocrine therapy: a pre-post quasi-interventional study.
trials.summary: Acupuncture reduced hot flashes and sleep problems in breast cancer patients taking hormone therapy.

trials.summary: Rectal cancer treatment is shifting toward precision approaches using robotic surgery, immunotherapy based on tumor genetics, and AI-guided strategies to improve outcomes and preserve function.

trials.title: [Bottlenecks and breakthroughs in gastric cancer diagnosis and treatment: Towards a new era of precision and intelligent integration].
trials.summary: Gastric cancer treatment is advancing through combining artificial intelligence and precision medicine to improve diagnosis, treatment selection, and patient outcomes.

trials.title: Dissecting Pirtobrutinib Resistance in Mantle Cell Lymphoma Through Single-Cell Multi-Omics.
trials.summary: Researchers identified genetic and non-genetic resistance mechanisms to pirtobrutinib in mantle cell lymphoma, suggesting chromatin regulators as potential therapeutic targets.

trials.title: Clinical Value of Patient-Derived Tumor Organoids in Guiding Precision Chemotherapy for Locally Advanced Thyroid Cancer: A Single-Center, Single-Arm, Phase 2 Trial.
trials.summary: Patient-derived tumor organoids successfully predicted chemotherapy response in advanced thyroid cancer, achieving 53% response rates and 87.5% in anaplastic cases.

trials.title: Imiquimod enhances anti-tumor effects of CD47 targeting in oral squamous cell carcinoma.
trials.summary: Imiquimod boosts the anti-tumor effects of CD47 targeting therapy in oral squamous cell carcinoma, potentially improving treatment outcomes.

trials.title: Burden Among Caregivers of Adult Patients with Neurofibromatosis Type 1 and Plexiform Neurofibroma in the United States: A Cross-Sectional Survey Study.
trials.summary: Caregivers of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1 experience significant emotional and physical burden, highlighting unmet support needs.

trials.title: Context defines precision: rethinking KRAS inhibition in oncology.
trials.summary: KRAS inhibitors work better when considering tumor type, genetic context, and immune factors, not just the KRAS mutation alone.

trials.title: Predicting clinically significant prostate cancer with or without digital rectal exam and MRI data using ClarityDX Prostate models.
trials.summary: AI models combining PSA levels with MRI imaging accurately predict clinically significant prostate cancer across diverse clinical settings.

mind_body.title: Implementing integrative nursing for oncology inpatients: a retrospective analysis of project-related routine data from 2021 to 2023.

mind_body.summary: Online mindfulness-based cognitive therapy reduced psychological distress in cancer patients and survivors, with benefits lasting at least three months.

mind_body.title: One Herd: A Community Storytelling Campaign for Equity in Adolescent and Young Adult Cancer Survivorship.
mind_body.summary: A storytelling campaign called One Herd elevates the voices and experiences of underserved adolescent and young adult cancer survivors from underrepresented communities.

mind_body.title: The Experience and Management of Cancer Screening-Related Anxiety in Fanconi Anemia: an Ethnographic Study
mind_body.summary: Study examines anxiety experienced by Fanconi anemia patients during frequent cancer screening visits through observational research methods.

mind_body.title: CBPR Intervention to Decrease Lung Cancer Stigma and Health Disparities (LUNGevity Lung Cancer Stigma Reduction)
mind_body.summary: Researchers tested a virtual mindfulness intervention to reduce lung cancer stigma and health disparities in underserved communities.

mind_body.summary: Brain tumor patients tested two interventions—cognitive rehabilitation with mindfulness versus educational videos—to improve thinking skills and brain health.

mind_body.title: Coping with primary brain tumors together: a scoping review of dyadic psychosocial interventions.
mind_body.summary: Couples-based counseling interventions help glioma patients and caregivers better cope with the disease's emotional and practical challenges.

mind_body.summary: To compare the therapeutic effect between warming acupuncture combined with Duhuo Jisheng decoction and Duhuo Jisheng decoction alone in the treatment of lumbar disc herniation (LDH) of qi stagnati...

mind_body.title: [Effects of electroacupuncture on gastrointestinal dysfunction and serum metabolites in postoperative patients with gastric cancer].
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture helps gastric cancer patients recover digestive function faster after surgery by improving gut movement.

mind_body.title: Effects of Preoperative Mindfulness Training Combined With Active Breathing and Circulation Exercises on Pulmonary Function Recovery in Lung Cancer Patients After Lobectomy.
mind_body.summary: Preoperative mindfulness training with breathing exercises improved lung function recovery in lung cancer patients after surgery.

mind_body.title: Chronic psychological stress disrupts liver homeostasis by dysregulating oxidative phosphorylation via the PI3K/AKT/FoxO3a axis.
mind_body.summary: Chronic psychological stress damages the liver by suppressing a cellular energy pathway through the PI3K/AKT/FoxO3a signaling axis.

mind_body.title: Mental adjustment to cancer and its predictors in patients with non-small cell lung cancer undergoing surgery.
mind_body.summary: Study identifies factors predicting how lung cancer surgery patients mentally adjust to their cancer diagnosis.

mind_body.title: Multicenter Randomized Controlled Trial Comparing Brief Behavioral Therapy for Cancer Related Insomnia (BBT-CI) and Healthy Eating Education Learning (HEAL)
mind_body.summary: A new study tests whether brief behavioral therapy helps cancer patients sleep better than a healthy eating education program.

mind_body.title: A Feasibility Trial Comparing the Effectiveness of Virtual YOCAS©® Yoga to Standard Care for Treating Insomnia in Cancer Survivors
mind_body.summary: Virtual yoga significantly improves insomnia and sleep quality in cancer survivors compared to standard care.
